Definition: Er, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: ʻÊr — Er — was the name of two Israelites: Judah's firstborn son, who died young in Canaan, and a later Er of Judah's line, the father of Lecah. Both appear in the genealogies, and neither gets more than a few verses.
TheologicalSignificance: I take Er as he stands: two men, one name, both remembered only in the record. That is enough — God kept their names when the story moved on.
